shared_elements: low-relief figural scene with figures facing the same direction
figures with raised or extended arms toward objects/animals
justification: Both surfaces show shallow-relief scenes of profile human figures oriented in one direction and interacting with animals or piled offerings, the closest correspondence being a figure with arm extended toward an animal/offering group. But A is a clean single-register procession of attendants leading two large horned rams past a stylised tree with a floral border, whereas B is an arched panel crowded with small figures, offering stands, plant/vessel forms and rows of sign-like marks, with no tree, no border of rosettes and no processional file of livestock.
